verdict.rationale: Khoj documents bring-your-own-key setup: you set OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY, add multiple chat models in the admin panel, and route through Ollama or LiteLLM. Nothing in the evidence shows token-usage or cost tracking per model or per conversation, which is half the story. Missing for 10: any documented token usage metering, per-model or per-conversation cost visibility, usage dashboards or reports, and independent corroboration.
